renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: College Accommodation Bureau, Darren speaking. How may I help you?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Oh, good morning. I'm starting at the college in September and I need to find some accommodation.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Right. Well, there are various options. The first one is to stay in college accommodation.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: That would be a single room.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 1
renderedGroups.text: The first type of accommodation is a single room in the college. So, single room has been written in the space.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 1
renderedGroups.text: Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 4.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: College Accommodation Bureau, Darren speaking.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: How may I help you?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Oh, good morning. I'm starting at the college in September and I need to find some accommodation.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Right.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, there are various options. The first one is to stay in college accommodation. That would be a single room.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: How much would that cost?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, it depends. For a standard room, you're looking at three thousand two hundred and seventy six pounds for the year. That's just for a room with washbasin.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Or three thousand eight hundred and thirty four pounds if you want an ensuite. That's with your own small bathroom.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: I see.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: That's more than I expected.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: It does include heating. That's quite a saving because energy costs can be high, especially in winter.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Hmm. Does it include meals as well?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: No. All our rooms are self-catering now.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: There's a shared kitchen on each corridor where you can cook if you want to or there are plenty of places to eat out on campus.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Okay. And you said that's the price for the whole year?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, you pay annually but actually it's for 36 weeks.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: It doesn't include holidays. You have to vacate the room then.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Oh, I need somewhere to stay in the holidays.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: I can't afford to go home. The flights are too expensive.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, there is another option.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Several families who either work at the college or have children studying here offer visiting students a room in their homes.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Oh?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: We call this arrangement home welcome and we've still got a few places left at the moment. You pay a hundred and fifty pounds per week and that includes breakfast, a packed lunch and dinner as well as heating.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Is there a contract? Do you have to stay for the whole year?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: No. It's flexible.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: It sounds really good but I'm not sure.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: I really want to be a little more independent.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 1
renderedGroups.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten on page two. Now listen and answer questions five to ten.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: What about finding somewhere to live off campus?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Yes, you can rent a property in town privately. You might want to rent a room in a shared house. You'd have a room of your own and share the kitchen and bathroom with other students.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: What about if I don't want to share?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: You can get what we call a studio. They're often quite small but they'll have everything you need.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Right.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: How much would those two options cost?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, prices vary depending on which part of town the property's in. Generally speaking, the cheapest is around 275 pounds a month for each student.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Oh, that's not too bad.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Yes, but it can also be as high as 490 pounds and then you'll have to pay all your other bills.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: What sort of amount would I be looking at for those?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Well, last year students were paying on average about 43 pounds per month each for gas and electricity. This year it'll probably be somewhere in the region of 48 pounds.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: That's a lot.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Yes, they've gone up quite a bit and on top of that you have to pay for water and that'll probably be around nine pounds.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: That didn't occur to me and I guess I'd have to pay for transportation, too.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: That's right. Most of these properties are quite a long way from the college.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: It just gets worse and worse.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: What's the minimum contract on this type of accommodation?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: Six months and you have to pay a deposit but of course you can stay there over the holidays.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: That's true.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: And you'd have to provide references.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: They want two from someone in this country.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: I see, but that's not a problem.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: If you do choose this option, we can't find the property for you.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 2
renderedGroups.text: You'd have to go through the estate agent which manages the property for the owner.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Right. Thanks.

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 3
renderedGroups.text: Well, I think I'd like to see what's available privately. Could you give me the estate agent details?

renderedGroups.speaker: Speaker 1
renderedGroups.text: That is the end of section 1. You now have half a minute to check your answers. Now turn to section 2 on page 3.
